title: Yrkie DOE Outline V1 — external authoring edition 1
description: The existing DOE V1 content format. Server semantic and security validation is also required. Byte limits are UTF-8; x-maxUtf8Bytes documents constraints outside standard JSON Schema.

title.description: Nonempty plain-text presentation title. No leading/trailing whitespace. At most 300 UTF-8 bytes. This is the outline title; it does not rename an existing project.

page_count.description: Must equal body.length exactly. This is authored page count, not authorization to run platform generation.

body.description: Pages in their intended reading order. Cover, agenda and conclusion pages count if supplied; none are inserted automatically.

index.description: Exactly this array position plus 1. Not a stable identifier.

page.description: Exactly the same value as index.

contents.description: Complete page content as ordered strings: title, conclusion, facts, paragraphs, numbers and units, chart/table descriptions, references or typed image plans. Prefer a plain-text page title first. No nested component objects.

items.description: Nonblank, trimmed plain text, at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes. Internal LF and tabs are permitted. HTML/SVG/scripts, active URI schemes, unsafe control characters and private references outside the complete image-reference contract are rejected. A standalone yrkie-asset-data:// reference with exactly 64 lowercase hex characters is accepted only when the server verifies its current user/project binding and availability; at most 256 placements. A standalone image plan uses this syntax: GENRATEIMG[type=content,ratio=4:3](A machine). Choose exactly one type (content or decorative) and one ratio (1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 4:5, 16:9 or 9:16); keep type before ratio without spaces in metadata. The description must be nonblank. At most 16 image plans per outline. Plans do not execute during creation.
